verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Drive publishes a REST v3 API reference (files, permissions, changes resources) and a discovery document. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as an in-page request explorer. A static reference and a machine-readable discovery document are adjacent to the story, not the capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
